paragraphs: Mentioned in Midrash Shmuel, chapter 17. Hyman reports that Pesikta de-Rav Kahana, at the printed locator 45a, has the statement as R' Avin in the name of R' Chanin; he says Midrash Shmuel should read likewise.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Hyman replaces a patronymic, bar Chanin, with a report in Rabbi Chanin’s name, citing the parallel Pesikta wording.

The whole Krakow 1893 digital Midrash Shmuel 17 paragraph has Rabbi Avin bar Rabbi Chanin, supporting the heading’s local first title. Hyman’s proposed replacement of a patronymic by an in-the-name-of chain is preserved with “should read.” His Pesikta 45a comparison was not freshly collated; search results silently removed the book filter and supply no proof. The inherited note remains verbatim.
